description.value:
You belong to a reclusive sect of Force-users who reject the strict light-versus-dark divide the Jedi and Sith cling to, believing instead that a person's own nature determines how their power is used. Your training pushed you to seek out and study every Force tradition you could find, not just one.

That restless curiosity has taken you across the galaxy, gathering fragments of philosophy and technique that most single-tradition Force users never bother to look for.

system.equipment: A copy of a Force-wielder organization's text, a trinket from your travels, a set of common clothes including a robe, and a belt pouch containing 150 credits.
